reason: Owner request 2026-11-19: add a pre-dispatch confirmation to minimise unfinished dispatched entries, and let a cake go with its box so the box is actually recorded (only 203 of 5598 cake deliveries carried one).
text: A cake dispatched from the commissary can carry its box as an ORDINARY SECOND LINE (category 'other' + name containing BOX), with the box qty mirroring the cake qty. No schema, endpoint or receiving change is needed: the branch counts the box like any line. The box list must NOT be 'all category other' - at RIZAL-COMMIS that also contains ECO BAG, EGG CRACKER, MILO SACHET and PANDESAL, which were offered as box sizes until the name filter was added; if a box is ever named without BOX this becomes an explicit per-product flag. The dispatch modal also now has a confirmation step ('No, for review' / 'Yes, Dispatch') that saves nothing on No - deliberately NOT a draft, because posting a draft lives on a page production_in_charge cannot open.
